Description.Name: Lutefisk Launcher Inspection Certificate
Description.Details: Any use of Cyclops Incorporated's Mortar Calibration systems requires an inspection of the weapon system when the calibrator is returned to Cyclops Inc or one of their affiliates to verify and ensure the weapon is working as intended and follows all safety protocols. This item is for the Jarl Lutefisk Launcher event chain only, it will not install in mechs. Advance 1 Day to trigger the event.
